meta.name: Signal Index
meta.notes: Monochrome cool off-white on a 12-column hairline grid; --c-primary only marks selected data: brushed histogram bars and band, active filters, price-range bars, cart count, primary buttons and the title highlight (darkened edge via color-mix keeps pastels legible).

issues: Homepage below the first product row was blank on desktop, mobile and stress: the .rv scroll reveal kept the rest of the grid, categories, story, quote, CTA and footer at opacity 0 (fallback only after 4 s)
The '+1 CART' toast sat visible mid-page in every capture, because translateY alone does not hide a fixed element in tall viewports
Missing prices showed as '€ —' everywhere (hero spec, cards, catalog rows), which reads as broken data in a template that is meant to be about trustworthy data
Catalog histogram without prices drew 24 flat dashes plus '€ — / —' axis labels, so the signature interaction looked broken instead of degrading on purpose
Creativity 7, typography 7.5, layout 7, polish 5, brand robustness 7 (gold Fredimare holds up), mobile 5.5 because content disappears, genericness: low
fixed: Reveal: elements already in the viewport show on load, and the safety net drops from 4 s to 1.2 s on both pages, so no section can stay blank
Toast is visibility:hidden until it is triggered (with a delayed visibility transition), on both pages
A missing price now renders as a mono 'Op aanvraag' / 'Prijs op aanvraag' data chip, a deliberate state that fits the index look

The histogram's no-price state hides the bars and axis and shows a hairline 24-bin grid with 'No price signal · prijzen op aanvraag · filter per categorie'. The readout says 'Op aanvraag' and the key label says 'PRICE / N.A.'
